name: vue-mcp-apps
description: Write MCP Apps as native Vue components (Nuxt UI) + a three-layer playground with in-browser AI demo

paragraphs: Write MCP Apps as plain Vue components (Nuxt UI included). Run the same component natively in your own Vue app and sandboxed in Claude, VS Code, Goose or ChatGPT. Test it in a three-layer playground — with an AI that runs in your browser.
▶ Live demo · Workbench · Integration guide · Architecture · Writing cards · AI demo · Claude skill
features: Cards are plain Vue SFCs. Props go in, events come out. Use Nuxt UI, Tailwind or any Vue library. A card imports nothing from MCP.
Native — mounts the card straight into your own Vue or Nuxt app (your chat, your dashboard). No iframe, no protocol, your plugins and styles.
MCP App — the same component, built into one self-contained template that fetches nothing, runs in any MCP Apps host.
